topography.project_purpose: Liquid Staking. Structurally: 40 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 6 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 4 common project-authored base contract(s) (erc20permit, eip712, erc2771context). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
